issue.body:
Starlette redirects on missing or redundant trailing slash. In pair with additional `--root-path` parameter on uvicorn it redirects to a wrong URI. Looks like starlette appends the same URI with filled or removed slash, but it's not considering root-path configuration, so that the path contains duplicated root.

### To reproduce

1. Configure endpoint without trailing slash - e.g. `/products`
2. Execute starlette application with uvicorn and pass `--root-path` parameter - e.g. `/api/v1/`
3. Call your endpoint with a redundant trailing slash - `/api/v1/products/`
4. Check 307 redirection path on your logs

### Expected behavior

Starlette redirects to `/api/v1/products`

### Actual behavior

Starlette redirects to `/api/v1/api/v1/products`

### Debugging material

<!-- Any tracebacks, screenshots, etc. that can help understanding the problem.

NOTE:
- Please list tracebacks in full (don't truncate them).
- Consider using `<details>` to make tracebacks/logs collapsible if they're very large (see https://gist.github.com/ericclemmons/b146fe5da72ca1f706b2ef72a20ac39d).
-->

### Environment

- OS: Linux/MacOS
- Python version: 3.9.0
- Starlette version: 0.13.6
issue.title: Duplicated root-path on 307 redirection
